findings.text: The marginal flag does not fail closed as section 4 requires. An independent current-head probe printed `absent (None, 'missing solver_qualification.marginal_solver_basin')`, `errors []`, `status pending`, `passes True` and exited 0: pending rows are excluded from exact parity, but receipt_errors accepts them, passes is derived only from errors, and main exits only when passes is false. The same probe printed `null (False, 'solver_qualification.marginal_solver_basin')`, because bool(None) silently turns an explicit JSON null into a governed non-marginal false value. Make missing and null qualification a validation error and process refusal, and pin both cases. The committed twelve-row receipt is unaffected because all twelve current flags are booleans; this is a durability defect in the guard, not a claim that the recorded census is wrong.

The plot does not render both complete null sets. draw_nulls receives the replayed magnetic axis and replayed X point plus only the committed X point as other_x_points; the committed magnetic axis is never drawn. The landed evidence admits this at docs/evidence/archive/plasma-cell-topology-authority-landed.html:169, while the section-4 contract at docs/plans/plasma-cell-topology-authority.html:94 requires both null sets. All twelve current axes coincide, so the omission is visually latent on this receipt, but a future axis movement would be hidden. The coverage test asserts only panel labels and cannot catch the missing marker.

The single cited file contains a valid green replay/test run and a red negative control, but it is not shaped as the declared durable record. Its first line is the host and timestamp rather than revision, worktree and command; the same path is cited as negative_control_log although its first line does not repeat the mutation; and the claimed base edc04e8c suite result (3 passed) is not present in this log or named by another log. The negative control itself is real: differing_cell_records returned records[:0], the focused regression failed with len(records)==0, NEG_CONTROL_EXIT=1, and NEG_RESTORED=1. Preserve that evidence in correctly headed logs and cite the base run rather than relying on manifest prose.

The section now carries the correct twelve-row landing at lines 96-99, but its canonical landed-summary at line 78 still says only two rows replay, ten are unavailable, six flags are unknown, and the receipt is pending. The worker explicitly left this as a follow-on and the later record is readable, but a live plan should not present two current verdicts for the same gate. Replace or clearly retire the two-row summary when the implementation is promoted.
